note: Population funnel records for three CENSUS dogfoods. Each level must reference a parent. Subset count cannot exceed parent count. Filters require explicit epistemic basis. WITNESS has NOT LANDED — all affected-level populations marked NOT_YET_MEASURED.

populations.name: All EU-27 commercial and public-sector buildings

inclusionCriteria.basis: Eurostat estimates ~220M total buildings EU-27; ~25% non-residential = ~55M

populations.notes: Extremely broad universe. Most units are not under EPC at all.

populations.name: Active Energy Performance Contracts in EU-27

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Contract is performance-based (ESCO or contractor guaranteed energy savings)
inclusionCriteria.basis: EUROACE ESCO market revenue EUR 3-5B/year; average project EUR 500K-5M implies 600-10,000 active contracts. BPIE cumulative 35,000+ projects / 5-year avg duration ≈ 7,000 active. See est-a02-eligible-count.

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Contract currently in its M&V measurement period
inclusionCriteria.basis: M&V period = contract active and not yet in warranty/maintenance-only phase

exclusionCriteria.criterion: Simple installation contracts without performance guarantee
Contracts in warranty-only or maintenance phase (post-M&V)

populations.notes: This is a DERIVED estimate with high uncertainty. Lower bound ~600 (conservative revenue/large-project assumption), upper bound ~10,000 (BPIE cumulative / short duration). Central range 2,000-7,000.

populations.name: EU-27 active EPCs exposed to M&V settlement obligation

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Contract contains a measurement and verification obligation (by definition of EPC)
inclusionCriteria.basis: IPMVP protocol: all EPCs require M&V for performance-based payment. Exposure = 100% of eligible.

populations.notes: Exposure = eligible. Every active EPC is exposed to M&V settlement by contractual definition.

populations.name: EU-27 active EPCs experiencing M&V settlement dispute

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Settlement calculation produces contested result requiring third-party resolution or extended negotiation
inclusionCriteria.basis: TERRAIN research gap — no public dispute rate exists. WITNESS has not landed.

populations.notes: PROBLEM PREVALENCE: NOT FIELD-ESTABLISHED. WITNESS has not landed. Cannot infer dispute rate from AI_HYPOTHESIS terrain. This is the highest-value unknown for DOGFOOD A.

populations.name: All EU-27+UK enterprises with 10+ employees (business economy)

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Employer enterprise with 10+ employees in business economy (NACE B-N excl K)
inclusionCriteria.basis: Eurostat SBS sbs_sc_ovw: approximately 1.3M enterprises 10+ employees EU-27

exclusionCriteria.criterion: Public administration (NACE O), agriculture (NACE A), financial sector (NACE K)

populations.notes: DOGFOOD B universe. Very broad. Unit here is enterprise-stock, not procurement-event-flow. Unit conversion required before revenue calculation.

populations.name: EU-27+UK manufacturing + regulated-sector enterprises 50+ employees

inclusionCriteria.basis: Eurostat SBS: EU-27 manufacturing enterprises 50-249 employees approx 35,000; 250+ approx 13,000. Total ~48,000.

inclusionCriteria.criterion: NACE J (ICT), M (professional services) 50+ employees where high-value B2B software purchases occur
inclusionCriteria.basis: Eurostat SBS: NACE J+M 50+ employees approximately 150,000 EU-27. But most software decisions in this sector are covered by review platforms (G2 etc) — partial exclusion needed.

exclusionCriteria.criterion: Enterprises <50 employees — less likely to make qualifying EUR 50K+ procurement decisions as structured events
Consumer-facing enterprises where procurement of capital equipment is not primary activity

populations.notes: CRITICAL: the billing unit is procurement-event-flow, not enterprise-stock. A stock count of 50,000 manufacturing enterprises is NOT the TAM. Events/enterprise/year assumption required for flow calculation.

populations.name: Annual high-stakes B2B procurement events in EU-27+UK manufacturing+regulated sectors

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Purchase decision >EUR 50K for capital equipment, regulated material, or complex B2B software
inclusionCriteria.basis: Derived: pop-b02 enterprise count × assumed 2-10 qualifying events/enterprise/year. Assumption has HIGH sensitivity.

exclusionCriteria.criterion: Repeat/renewal purchases of standard consumables without performance evaluation

populations.notes: UNIT CONVERSION from stock to flow. The 2-10 events/enterprise/year assumption is the dominant sensitivity factor. No public source counts qualifying procurement events directly.

populations.name: Annual events where evidence asymmetry causes material procurement friction

inclusionCriteria.criterion: No adequate independent evidence available for the specific product configuration and use case
inclusionCriteria.basis: TERRAIN: AI_HYPOTHESIS only. WITNESS has not landed. No qualitative interviews conducted.

populations.notes: PROBLEM PREVALENCE: NOT FIELD-ESTABLISHED. Cannot infer from AI_HYPOTHESIS. Counter-evidence in TERRAIN notes that G2/Gartner partially cover SaaS — meaning a material fraction of eligible events may already be served. Upper bound = entire eligible population. True affected fraction = UNKNOWN.

populations.name: All EU-27+UK energy-intensive industrial enterprises 250+ employees

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Energy-intensive industry NACE B (mining), C20-C24 (chemicals, metals, plastics), D35 (energy utilities), 250+ employees
inclusionCriteria.basis: Eurostat SBS: approximately 15,000-20,000 enterprises in these categories 250+ employees EU-27

exclusionCriteria.criterion: Enterprises <250 employees — less likely to have 1MW+ flexible load capacity
exclusionCriteria.basis: ASSUMPTION on load size correlation with employee count

populations.notes: DOGFOOD C universe. Enterprise count (stock) — not the same as flexibility site count. One enterprise may operate multiple sites.

populations.name: EU-27+UK registered grid flexibility sites (1MW+ enrolled)

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Site formally registered with TSO or aggregator for balancing/DR market participation with minimum 1MW flexible load
inclusionCriteria.basis: ENTSO-E capacity approach: FCR contracted capacity ~3,000 MW EU-wide / assumed 1-5 MW average site → 600-3,000 sites (lower bound, TSO markets only).

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Counter-estimate via aggregator count: ACER/TERRAIN 200+ aggregators × 10-50 sites/aggregator → 2,000-10,000 sites

exclusionCriteria.criterion: DSO-managed local flexibility markets (not captured in ENTSO-E data)
Sites <1MW that aggregate via virtual battery systems

populations.notes: Two independent methods produce consistent ranges. Lower bound 600 (ENTSO-E capacity approach, TSO markets only). Upper bound 10,000 (aggregator-based, includes DSO estimates). Preferred range 2,000-5,000 pending ENTSO-E BSP register download.

populations.name: Flexibility sites experiencing identifier-mismatch settlement disputes

inclusionCriteria.criterion: Site uses legacy SCADA with site-internal meter IDs incompatible with MPRN/MPAN scheme
inclusionCriteria.basis: TERRAIN: AI_HYPOTHESIS. Structurally inherent in pre-smart-meter SCADA installations, but actual prevalence unknown.

populations.notes: PROBLEM PREVALENCE: NOT FIELD-ESTABLISHED. TERRAIN counter-evidence notes that smart meter rollout and market reforms may gradually reduce the SCADA/MPRN mismatch over time. True affected fraction = UNKNOWN.
